sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Shiv Prakash Hon'ble Ashwani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Syed Aftab Husain Rizvi,J.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

This petition has been filed with a prayer to quash the FIR in case crime no.331 of 2023 U/s 498A,
354, 323, 506, 376 IPC, 3/4 D.P. Act & 3/4 Muslim Women Marriage Act, P.s. Katghar, District Moradabad.
The argument that the allegations are not substantiated U/s 161 Cr.P.C. can hardly be a ground to quash the FIR.

We have perused the FIR which contains specific allegations with regard to demand of dowry;
outraging the modesty of the victim and also sexual assault on her.
The injury report has also been annexed.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the fact that the parties are in a matrimonial relationship, we offered the parties to avail the remedy of mediation but the parties are apparently not agreeable in it.
Learned counsel for the informant points out that the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner has been rejected on 09.08.2023.

Since prima-facie, allegation with regard to commissioning of cognizable offence is disclosed in the FIR, we decline to embark upon a factual enquiry at this stage so as to ascertain as to whether these allegations are correct or not.
The writ petition is accordingly, dismissed.

Order Date :- 18.9.2023 /C. MANI  Farman vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15322969/
